title: Fast dotnet test runner over Barcade.Core (TDD inner loop)
description: Stand up a standalone dotnet/NUnit test project that compiles the engine-free Barcade.Core sources and the pure-logic EditMode test files, so the TDD inner loop for logic tickets runs in seconds instead of multi-minute Unity batchmode. Unity batchmode remains the verifier for engine-dependent code (input, scenes, HUD, Addressables) and a final integration pass. Single source of truth: the dotnet project LINKS the existing test .cs files (no duplicate tests). Installs the .NET SDK user-scoped (no admin).
acceptance_criteria: A .NET SDK is available (install user-scoped via the official dotnet-install script into a user-local dir if none is present; do NOT require admin).

A test project under D:/barcade/fast-tests/ compiles the Barcade.Core sources (via linked Compile includes from Barcade/Assets/Barcade/Core) and the pure-logic test files (InputSnapshotTests, PlayerSlotTests, SeededRandomTests; exclude any file that references UnityEngine or UnityEngine.TestTools).
`dotnet test` runs green and completes in seconds, covering the same pure-logic assertions that pass under Unity (player slots, InputSnapshot, SeededRandom).
The fast-tests project lives OUTSIDE the Unity project (so Unity does not compile it) and its bin/obj are gitignored.
A short note documents the fast test command and when to use it vs Unity batchmode (in .claude/skills/unity-testing or a fast-tests/README).

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Done. Fast dotnet/NUnit runner at fast-tests/Barcade.Core.FastTests links (not copies) the Barcade.Core sources + pure EditMode test files; 44 tests pass in <5s (vs ~2h via Unity). .NET SDK 8.0.422 installed user-scoped at ~/.dotnet (no admin). gitignore excludes bin/obj; project sits outside the Unity project so Unity never compiles it. Orchestrator-verified directly (links + green run + isolation). Commit 0470eef. This is now the TDD inner loop for pure Barcade.Core tickets; Unity batchmode reserved for engine-dependent code + a final integration pass. Pre-existing NUnit2007 warning in SmokeTests left for its owning ticket.
